read.thesis: Q4 CY25 production update shows broad volume strength (CuEq +8% in 2025, copper +11%, record Pilbara Q4 run rate) but supply additions are heavy, with Simandou ramp, Oyu Tolgoi and lithium growth, and Pilbara system capacity flagged at 345–360Mtpa.

utilisation.quote: Record quarterly run rate of around 360 Mtpa driven by continued investment in mine health and productivity, and favourable weather.

triggers.label: Simandou first shipment, 30-month ramp
triggers.quote: once complete, around the end of Q1 2026, we expect a 30 month ramp-up to full capacity

triggers.label: Lithium carbonate price +55% in Q4
triggers.quote: The lithium carbonate price increased 55% in Q4 fuelled by growing optimism for battery energy storage systems demand
triggers.highlight: The lithium carbonate price increased 55% in Q4

triggers.label: Yarwun alumina output cut 40% from Oct 2026
triggers.quote: we will reduce production by 40% from October 2026, to extend the operation's life until 2035

triggers.label: TiO2 feedstock supply curtailed ~5% YoY
triggers.quote: some TiO2 feedstock supply was curtailed in 2025; supply is estimated to have declined ~5% year- on-year
triggers.highlight: supply is estimated to have declined ~5% year- on-year
